params.name: filter
params.description: Optional filtering agents based on name or wallet address

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional field(s) to sort by. Supports single or multiple fields separated by commas.
Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g., '-name' or 'name,-createdAt').
Available fields: id, ownerId, walletAddress, name, description, imageUrl, status, createdAt, updatedAt.
When not specified, results are returned in database order.

params.name: limit
params.description: Optional field to choose max size of result set (default value is `10`)

params.name: offset
params.description: Optional field to choose offset of result set (default value is `0`)
